title: Do Sanctions Backfire? New Evidence on the Macroeconomic Effects of Supporting Ukraine
hypothesis: Main boomerang operates through prices not output incremental post-2022 CPI gap 0.072 log points about 7.5% significant robust vs no robust aggregate GDP-per-capita loss growth differential -3.9pp; within coalition 1 SD Russian fossil-energy imports/GDP associated +2.2pp CPI differential +0.64pp inflation and -0.96pp annual GDPpc growth exposure gradient steeper for sanctioners for CPI beta3 0.0195 p<0.05 and growth -1.2875 p<0.01.
data_sources: World Development Indicators FP.CPI.TOTL NY.GDP.PCAP.KD etc 8 controls rule of law WGI
UN Comtrade coal crude refined gas Russian imports and world gas total imports current USD for exposure measures

author-coded strict sanctions ledger Council Regulation EU 833/2014 alignment declarations Switzerland ordinance 2 April 2014 New Zealand 2022 Singapore South Korea March 2022 cross-checked Ukraine Support Tracker Trebesch2023 Global Sanctions Data Base direct-arming verifiable delivery commitment
sample: Balanced annual panel of 129 countries for 2000--2024 yielding 3,225 country-years. Effective estimation period 2001--2024 after one-year lag of 8 controls. Outcomes: log CPI, log real GDP per capita, annual inflation, GDP-per-capita growth. Controls with one-year lag: oil rents, trade openness, terms of trade, investment rate, government consumption, rule of law, population growth, fuel-share balance. Country eligibility on raw 2000--2024 before any repair: each of 4 outcomes <=35% missing, at most one of 8 controls >25% missing, no control >65% missing, CPI and real GDP per capita each <=25% missing in 2019--2024 critical window; excludes Syria and Sudan from 131 otherwise eligible to give final N=129. Treatment definitions separate by policy and outcome: strict-sanctions coalition 42 main estimation targets descriptive 43 coded including Ukraine and 3 geopolitical exclusions Russia Belarus Ukraine never donors, donors 84/84 for log CPI/log GDPpc; direct-arming coalition 29 targets 28 both plus 1 only, donors 96 CPI 97 GDPpc. Raw missing 57 of 12,900 outcome cells 0.44% 25 CPI 32 inflation 55 leading bounded-trend backcasts 2000--2007 plus 2 Bosnia 2024 carried forward from 2023; 1,471 of 25,800 control cells 5.70% completed by deterministic hierarchy interpolation/bounded extrapolation. Exposure heterogeneity analysis separate Comtrade sample intersecting 126-country mechanism universe: strict rule >=3 usable years <=1 imputed per component gives 118 2018--2021 and 119 2010--2013 regression countries with 39 sanctioners each, 122--120 construction counts, Austria Germany Poland Turkiye excluded for pipeline-gas undercoverage.
method: Step 1 Construct donor factor proxy fhat_t = [1,mean donor outcome_{t,C_Y}] for each policy-outcome pair using only never-treated eligible donors C_Y for every year t, stacked into T0=13 x2 matrix Fhat 2001--2013.

Step 2 Estimate pre-treatment relationship t<=2013: Y_it = X_{i,t-1}'beta + alphai'fhat_t + u_it by OLS after residualizing with M_Fhat = I - Fhat(Fhat'Fhat)^{-1}Fhat'. Pooled beta_hat = (sum_i X_i'M_Fhat X_i)^{-1} sum_i X_i'M_Fhat Y_i over S_Y target+donor set; alphai_hat = (Fhat'Fhat)^{-1}Fhat'(Y_i - X_i beta_hat). K=8 lagged controls; use Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse if rank-deficient; omit negligible residual-variance control columns assign 0.

Step 3 Construct post-treatment untreated counterfactual for t>=2014: estimate proxy-to-covariate loadings Lambda_i_hat = (Fhat'Fhat)^{-1}Fhat' X_i 2xK, impute untreated covariates Xhat_{i,t-1}(inf)=Lambda_i_hat' fhat_t, then untreated outcome Yhat_it(inf)= Xhat_{i,t-1}(inf)'beta_hat + gammai_hat'fhat_t where gammai_hat = (Fhat'Fhat)^{-1}Fhat'(Y_i - X_i beta_hat). Never insert target observed post-2013 X.
Step 4 Country-year gaps ghat_it = Y_it - Yhat_it(inf); positive means observed above imputed untreated path.

Step 5 Aggregate equally weighted coalition ATT: wave windows W1=2014--2021 W2=2022--2024, country window mean gbar_{i,W}=|W|^{-1} sum_{t in W} ghat_it, ATT_W = N_T^{-1} sum_{i in T*} gbar_{i,W} N_T=|T*|. Incremental post-2022 contrast ATT_Inc2 = N_T^{-1} sum_i [gbar_{i,W2} - gbar_{i,R}] with R=2019--2021 preferred reference; alternatives 2017--2019, 2021, 2017--2021, 2018--2021; log-point estimate percentage exact 100[exp(theta)-1] approx 100theta.

Step 6 Inference from N_T country-level complete contrasts d_i = gbar_{i,W2}-gbar_{i,R}: country-dispersion SE_CD=sd(d_i)/sqrt(N_T) t_CD=ATT/SE_CD p_CD =2[1-F_{t_{N_T-1}}(|t_CD|)] stars only source * p<0.10 ** p<0.05 *** p<0.01. Country-history bootstrap B=500 resample N_T target and N_C donor whole-country 2000--2024 histories with replacement rebuild factor re-estimate full design per draw, store 5 reference-window ATTs; region-block bootstrap B=500 resample G World Bank regions with replacement multiplicity a_gb keep same-region countries together rebuild factor; percentile CI 2.5th 97.5th. Size-matched placebo B=500 draw pseudo-target set T_b^P uniform without replacement of size N_T from C^Y donors remaining C_b^P rebuild factor re-estimate, two-sided empirical p = [1+sum_b 1{|ATT_b^P|>=|ATT|})/(B+1) plus-one correction, one-sided also stored, seed 12345.

Step 7 Robustness: donor-pool variants corrected full vs no repaired main-outcome cells vs high-income donors; factor-proxy variants own-outcome mean, other-outcome mean, both, own+oil rents, own+fuel-share balance with rank/condition diagnostics; matched donor designs high-income sample median 2009--2013 GDPpc p50 and Mahalanobis 5 nearest donors frequency-weighted distance m_ij=[(Z_i-Z_j)' (S_Z+1e-6 I)^+ (Z_i-Z_j)]^{1/2} standardized difference SD_k=(Q_Tbar -Q_Cbar)/s_QI; influence diagnostics treated LOO ATT_{(-i)}=(N_T-1)^{-1} sum_{k!=i} d_k and donor LOO rebuild factor full re-estimation; horizon checks active-years only and exclude 2024 2022--2023; rate outcomes inflation/GDPpc growth decimals.

Step 8 Exposure heterogeneity separate CCE interaction on observed panel Post_t=1 2022--2024 omitted earlier years without 8 lagged controls: Y_it = mu_i + lambda_i Ybar_{C,t} + beta1 S_i Post_t + beta2 E_iw Post_t + beta3 S_i E_iw Post_t + u_it, S_i sanctions coalition, E_iw Russian fossil-energy imports/GDP sum_t in w numerator Coal+Crude+Refined+Gas Russia denominators sum GDP standardized within regression sample w=2018--2021 near-prewar and 2010--2013 pre-Crimea, country intercepts mu_i heterogenous loadings lambda_i on non-policy CSA, country-clustered SE. Interpret beta1 differential at mean exposure, beta2 slope among non-sanctioners, beta3 difference slopes, beta2+beta3 total slope among sanctioners. Strict sample >=3 usable years <=1 imputed per component, extended +Kenya 2010--2013 to 120.
